https://support.mozilla.org/en-US/kb/getting-started-thunderbird-pro https://thundermail.com/

Thundermail is an email service while Thunderbird is a email client where you can do things such as manage multiple email accounts (via IMAP or POP3) which can include Thundermail. Thundermail is email hosting with custom domain support and aliases.

So no, Thundermail will not replace the Thunderbird email client.

content:
That's just the Start Page. Whenever you open a message, its contents will be displayed there. You have it pushed all the way up so it's obscuring the message list, but you can drag it down to see both. Press <F8> to toggle the pane between visible and hidden. You can disable the Start Page entirely in <Settings | General>

This article describes it in more detail:

https://support.mozilla.org/en-US/kb/how-disable-or-change-thunderbird-start-page
